description: A title given as an **array** is one line per element, exactly as an axis title and a legend title are. An axis's and a legend's already followed that rule — the axis builder carries a comment saying `resolveLines`, not `resolveText`, because stringifying an array joins it with a comma on one line — and the chart's own title and subtitle were the two places that did not. `['two', 'lines']` is a heading 28 pixels tall against a single line's 13, so getting it wrong leaves the whole drawing fifteen pixels short and the heading reading `two,lines`. The signals here hold the arrays, which is how a trellis header or a control-driven heading arrives; the axis and legend titles beside them are the two that were already right, so the fixture compares all four against each other as well as against upstream.
